For r<Rδ disjoint disk-edge segments yield Fδ(r)=πr²−2ΣS(r,h_j) with h=(1,√(1+δ²),√(2−2δ+δ²))/2. Endpoint differentiation gives Cδ=2[1/δ+1/(1−δ)+1/(1−δ+δ²)]; the square has C0=4.
